product_overview: Online Invoice Creator is a free browser-based tool for making invoices, receipts, and rent receipts with live preview and instant PDF export. Users can create professional documents without signing up, uploading data, or adding watermarks.
core_goals: Create professional invoices online with editable business, client, and billing details
Add line items, taxes, discounts, shipping, and currency formatting to calculate totals accurately
Upload a logo and preview the document live before downloading or printing
Save draft data in the browser and restore it later without an account
Generate specialized receipts and template-based invoices for freelancers, contractors, Australian tax invoices, and rent receipts
Download clean PDF documents directly from the browser

features.name: Invoice Creation and Editing
features.description: Let users build a complete invoice by entering header details, business information, client information, line items, and payment details while watching the preview update live.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter invoice number, issue date, due date, purchase order number, and payment terms -> Enter sender business details and recipient client details -> Add line items with descriptions, quantities, and rates -> Review the live preview and updated totals -> Download the invoice as a PDF

Navigate to / -> Enter invoice details -> Leave the client name empty and attempt to continue -> See field-level validation prompts and focus move to the first missing required field -> Complete the missing information -> Download the invoice as a PDF

features.name: Pricing, Tax, Discount, Shipping, and Currency Controls
features.description: Allow users to adjust totals with tax, discount, shipping, and currency settings while formatting amounts correctly for the chosen locale.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Add one or more line items -> Select a currency -> Enable tax and enter a tax rate -> Enable discount and enter either a percentage or fixed amount -> Enter shipping or handling charges -> Review the recalculated grand total in the preview

Navigate to / -> Add line items -> Enter a discount larger than the subtotal -> See the discount clamp to zero with an explanatory message -> Review the corrected total -> Download the invoice as a PDF

features.name: Logo Upload and Visual Branding
features.description: Enable users to add a company logo to the invoice and remove it when needed.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Upload a logo image -> See the logo appear in the invoice preview -> Continue editing the invoice with the branded layout -> Download the invoice as a PDF
Navigate to / -> Upload a logo image -> Review the preview -> Remove the logo -> See the invoice return to a plain layout -> Download the invoice as a PDF

features.name: Template Switching and Live Preview
features.description: Let users switch between invoice templates while keeping all entered data intact and comparing the preview instantly.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in invoice details and line items -> Switch between available templates -> See the preview restyle without losing entered data -> Download the selected version as a PDF
Navigate to / -> Enter invoice data -> Change the template on a mobile-sized layout -> Switch back to the previous template -> Confirm the data remains intact in the preview

features.name: PDF Download and Printing
features.description: Allow users to export the finished invoice or receipt as a PDF and open print mode from the browser.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Complete the invoice form -> Choose to download the document as a PDF -> Wait for the file to generate -> Save the PDF to the device
Navigate to / -> Complete the invoice form -> Open print mode -> See the browser print preview dialog -> Cancel or proceed with printing

features.name: Browser Draft Saving and Reset
features.description: Persist invoice data locally in the browser and let users clear everything with confirmation.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter invoice details -> Observe the draft being saved locally -> Refresh the page -> See the same data restored from browser storage
Navigate to / -> Enter invoice details -> Choose to clear saved data -> Confirm the reset -> See a blank invoice form restored

features.name: Freelancer Invoice Template
features.description: Provide a freelancer-focused invoice page with fields suited to project work and payment terms.
user_flows: Navigate to /invoice-generator-for-freelancers -> Enter freelancer project details and billing information -> Add rates and payment terms -> Review the freelancer-oriented preview -> Download the invoice as a PDF

features.name: Contractor Invoice Template
features.description: Provide a contractor-focused invoice page with separate labor and material billing.
user_flows: Navigate to /contractor-invoice-template -> Enter labor hours and material expenses -> Review the separated totals in the preview -> Add any additional billing details -> Download the contractor invoice as a PDF

features.name: Australian Tax Invoice Template
features.description: Provide an Australia-specific tax invoice page with ABN and GST handling.
user_flows: Navigate to /tax-invoice-template-australia -> Enter the ABN -> Add invoice items -> Review the automatic GST calculation in the preview -> Download the Australian tax invoice as a PDF

features.name: Receipt Generator
features.description: Let users create a sales receipt with payment method, transaction details, and itemized lines.
user_flows: Navigate to /free-online-receipt-generator -> Select a payment method -> Enter transaction details and store or cashier information -> Add itemized purchase lines with tax -> Download the receipt as a PDF

features.name: Itemized Receipt Maker
features.description: Let users create a detailed receipt with quantities, unit pricing, and tax totals.
user_flows: Navigate to /receipt-maker-with-items -> Add receipt items with descriptions, quantities, and prices -> Enter tax information -> Review the calculated receipt totals -> Download the itemized receipt as a PDF

features.name: Rent Receipt Generation
features.description: Allow landlords and tenants to create a monthly rent receipt with property and payment details.
user_flows: Navigate to /free-rent-receipt-generator -> Enter landlord name, tenant name, property address, and rent period -> Enter the rent amount and payment method -> Review the printable rent receipt preview -> Download the rent receipt as a PDF

features.name: Contact Support Form
features.description: Let users send feedback or support requests through a contact form with confirmation after submission.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Enter name, email, and message -> Submit the form -> See a submission confirmation or feedback status

features.name: Invoice Header & Meta Configuration
features.description: Edit invoice number, PO number, issue date, due date, and payment terms
user_interactions: Type custom invoice title or number into invoice number input
Select invoice issue date from datepicker
Select invoice payment due date
Enter purchase order (PO) number
Choose payment terms dropdown option
View live updates reflected synchronously in invoice preview

features.name: Company & Client Profiles
features.description: Enter sender company details and client billing information
user_interactions: Enter sender business name, address, email, phone, and tax registration
Enter recipient client company name, contact person, email, and billing address
Toggle ship-to address section if shipping is required
Verify sender and recipient details render immediately in the preview pane

features.name: Line Item Management & Calculations
features.description: Add, remove, reorder line items with description, quantity, rate, and automatic line totals
user_interactions: Click Add Item button to insert a new line item row
Enter item description text
Enter quantity value with number stepper or direct input
Enter unit price or hourly rate
Click remove or delete button on an item row to delete it
Verify subtotal, tax amounts, and total recalculate in real-time

features.name: Tax, Discount, and Shipping Adjustments
features.description: Configure percentage or flat discounts, sales tax rates, and shipping charges
user_interactions: Toggle discount option and input discount percentage or fixed amount
Toggle tax option and input sales tax or VAT percentage
Enter shipping fee or handling surcharge
Verify calculated grand total updates accurately without page refresh

features.name: Currency Selector & Formatting
features.description: Choose from over 30 international currencies with proper symbol and decimal formatting
user_interactions: Click currency dropdown selector
Select currency (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD, INR, JPY)
Confirm currency symbol and decimal formatting update across all amounts

features.name: Logo Upload & Image Embedding
features.description: Upload custom company logo to display on invoices and receipts
user_interactions: Click logo upload button or drag and drop image file (PNG/JPG/SVG)
View instant logo preview rendered on the invoice template
Click remove logo button to clear uploaded logo

features.name: Payment QR Code Generator
features.description: Generate embedded QR code for bank transfers, UPI, or payment links
user_interactions: Toggle Payment QR code feature
Input payment URL, UPI ID, or bank reference
Verify QR code is generated and embedded directly into the invoice layout

features.name: PDF Export & Print Execution
features.description: Generate high-resolution PDF document and trigger browser print dialog
user_interactions: Click Download PDF button
Wait for client-side rendering with jsPDF and html2canvas
Verify PDF file downloads with invoice filename pattern
Click Print button to trigger native browser print preview dialog

features.name: Local Storage Draft Auto-Save & Reset
features.description: Automatically persist invoice state to browser localStorage and allow one-click reset
user_interactions: Modify invoice fields and observe autosave indicator
Refresh browser page and observe all entered data restored from localStorage
Click Clear / Reset button and confirm dialog to revert to a blank template

features.name: Contractor Invoice Workflow
features.description: Specialized contractor invoice fields for labor, materials, and subcontractor line items
user_interactions: Navigate to contractor invoice template
Add separate labor hours and material expenses
Verify total calculation separates labor and materials
Download contractor PDF invoice

features.name: Receipt Maker Workflow
features.description: Specialized sales receipt generator with payment method and transaction ID
user_interactions: Navigate to receipt generator
Select payment method (Cash, Credit Card, Bank Transfer)
Enter receipt transaction number and cashier or store name
Add items with unit pricing and tax
Download receipt PDF

features.name: Rent Receipt Generation
features.description: Issue monthly rental proof-of-payment receipts for landlords and tenants
user_interactions: Navigate to rent receipt generator
Input property rental address, landlord name, tenant name, and rent month/period
Enter rental amount paid and payment method
Generate and download printable rent receipt

features.name: Australian Tax Invoice with 10% GST
features.description: Create ATO compliant tax invoices with ABN and GST breakdown
user_interactions: Navigate to Australia tax invoice template
Enter Australian Business Number (ABN)
Add items and verify automatic 10% GST calculation
Download ATO compliant Australian tax invoice PDF

features.name: Freelancer Invoice Creator
features.description: Specialized billing tool for creative and technical freelancers
user_interactions: Navigate to freelancer invoice generator
Enter hourly or project deliverables
Add payment terms and late payment notice
Download invoice PDF

features.name: Contact Support Form
features.description: Form to send feedback or report technical issues
user_interactions: Fill full name, email address, and message text
Click Send Message button
See submission confirmation or feedback status
